items.q: Is Doctor Food a replacement for my doctor?
items.a: No. Doctor Food offers nutrition guidance and meal ideas. It isn't medical advice, so talk to your doctor about any medical condition or medication.
You set your allergies once. Doctor Food flags likely allergens in meals and recipes and suggests swaps. For severe allergies, always check product labels too.

items.q: Which devices does it work on?
items.a: Doctor Food is available on iOS and Android.
The app is free to download and includes three AI questions. Paid plans add credits every month or year. See the pricing section for each plan.
Each AI request uses credits. Your plan gives you a set number of credits per month or per year. Unused credits don't roll over.

items.q: Can the whole family use one plan?
items.a: Yes. The Family plan is built for the whole household and includes the largest credit allowance.

items.q: Does it help with weight goals?
items.a: Yes. Choose a goal such as weight loss and Doctor Food sets realistic calorie targets and meals, then adjusts them as you progress.

items.q: What if my allergy is severe?
items.a: Doctor Food flags likely allergens to help you, but it can't guarantee that a food is safe. For severe allergies, always read product labels and follow your allergist's advice.

items.q: Can I track what I eat every day?
items.a: Yes. Log a meal in seconds and see calories and macros for the day in one view.

About.title: About Doctor Food
About.intro: Doctor Food is a health-tech platform that combines artificial intelligence with nutritional science to help people reach their wellness goals. Founded in 2023, we've grown to serve over 500,000 active users worldwide.
About.mission: We believe everyone deserves personalised, expert-level nutrition guidance. Our mission is to make AI-powered dietary recommendations accessible to all.
About.story: Doctor Food started from a simple observation: despite all the diet information available, people still struggle to find personalised nutrition advice that works for their needs. Our founders, a team of nutritionists, data scientists and health enthusiasts, set out to solve that with modern AI.
About.what: We provide intelligent meal planning and nutrition tracking that adapts to your lifestyle, preferences and health goals. Our AI looks at your eating patterns, finds areas to improve and suggests changes that fit into your daily routine.

values.title: Science-based
values.body: Our recommendations are grounded in peer-reviewed nutrition research.

values.title: Privacy-first
values.body: Your health data is encrypted and never shared without your explicit consent.

values.title: Inclusive
values.body: We support all dietary preferences, restrictions and cultural food traditions.

values.title: Transparent
values.body: We explain the reasoning behind every recommendation we make.

About.team: Doctor Food is powered by a diverse team of registered dietitians, machine learning engineers, UX designers and health advocates. Together we're making healthy eating simple, enjoyable and sustainable.
About.join: We're always looking for passionate people to join our mission. Check out our careers page or write to careers@fooddoctor.com.
